title: Covered Checked Bags Under Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions — Desk Guidance
content:
**The rule the desk applies.** A Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product that covers bags covers the subscription's number of checked bags per direction, each up to the subscription's heaviest covered bag weight, for the subscriber and each covered companion on the same reservation, on itineraries whose itinerary class is one of the subscription's bag itinerary classes. Overweight and oversize charges stay payable unless the subscription covers overweight or oversize charges.

## When the benefit may be used

- **Status of the subscription.** Benefits are used only while the subscription is active. The status is the one the company's records show for the very subscription whose benefit is being used, read before the use is recorded; a subscription that is purchased but not yet started, expired or cancelled gives no bag benefit.
- **Travelers.** The subscriber and each covered companion on the same reservation. No one other than the subscriber and covered companions may use the benefit when the subscription does not allow household sharing.
- **Kinds of ticket and flight.** Benefits never apply on partner-operated flights when the subscription does not apply to partner flights, never on Crestline Basic Economy unless the subscription applies to Basic Economy, and never on group fares unless the subscription applies to group bookings; on Summit award tickets and on companion-certificate tickets they apply as the subscription's award-ticket and companion-ticket settings say.
- **Uses in the term.** Uses in the current term may not exceed the subscription's most benefit uses per term. The uses counted are the covered-bag uses and the covered-seat uses recorded on the subscription and dated inside the current term, from its start date to the date the matter is handled. Covered bags are recorded as one use per traveler per ticket direction.

## Bag fees paid before the purchase

Bag fees already paid on directions flown within the subscription's bag-fee refund window, counted in calendar days before the purchase date of the subscription, are refunded under the fee-refund rule of the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules as charged in error.

## Judgement table

| Fact on the records | Result |
|---|---|
| Subscription status active; itinerary class among the subscription's bag itinerary classes; ticket kind not excluded; uses within the term allowance | Bags covered up to the per-direction count and weight limit |
| Subscription status purchased, expired or cancelled | No bag benefit |
| Bag heavier than the covered weight limit, subscription not covering overweight | Weight above the limit charged under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules |
| Traveler neither the subscriber nor a covered companion, household sharing not allowed | No bag benefit for that traveler |

## Cases on both sides (hypothetical figures)

- **Term allowance.** With a hypothetical allowance of 150 uses, a subscription with 149 uses recorded in the current term may record one more, reaching 150; a subscription with 150 uses recorded may not record another, since the count would exceed 150.
- **Counting travelers.** A subscriber and one covered companion each checking covered bags on the outbound direction of the same reservation account for 2 uses, one per traveler for that direction.
- **Fees paid before purchase.** With a hypothetical window of 7 calendar days, a bag fee paid on a direction flown 3 days before the purchase date is refunded as charged in error; a bag fee paid on a direction flown 20 days before the purchase date is not refunded under this rule.
